argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$p='E:\WebAIBridge';$h=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/health' -TimeoutSec 6;$cut=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/projects/control-plane/cutover-r42/status' -TimeoutSec 6;$op=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/operator-lifecycle' -TimeoutSec 6;$a=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments' -TimeoutSec 6;Write-Output ('GIT_HEAD='+((& git.exe -C $p rev-parse HEAD)|Out-String).Trim());Write-Output ('GIT_TRACKED_DIRTY='+(@(& git.exe -C $p status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no).Count));Write-Output ('HEALTH='+$h.state);Write-Output ('HEALTH_REASONS='+(@($h.reasons)-join ','));Write-Output ('R42_HOLD='+$cut.cutoverState.holdActive);Write-Output ('R42_STATUS='+$cut.cutoverState.status);Write-Output ('OP_MODE='+$op.mode);Write-Output ('QUEUE_PAUSED='+$op.queuePaused);Write-Output ('QUEUED='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -eq 'queued'}).Count);Write-Output ('ACTIVE='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -in @('dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count);Write-Output ('SERVER_HASH='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p 'app\server.js') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)
